evidence.evidence_excerpt: Selecting a nonexistent test method discovered one test, matched none, and exited zero.
The merged change introduced TreatNoTestsAsError for non-zero status when no tests are available.

intended_control: Execute an explicitly selected the language runtime test and expose success or failure through process status.
false_acceptance: A selection matching no test returned process status zero, indistinguishable to a status-only CI gate from a passing run.

causal_chain.claim: The issue reproduces the behavior with a nonexistent test method.
The runner reported that no test matched and returned zero.
The merged remedy added an explicit option to make no tests an error.

steps: Build the issue's one-test the language runtime Framework project.
Invoke the test runner with /tests naming TestMethod2, which does not exist.
Observe the selection diagnostic and process status.
reproducer.observed: No test matched the selection criteria; process status was zero.
reproducer.expected: A non-zero status when the explicit selection executes no tests.

facts: The report supplies two reproduction routes and full console output.
derivations: A status-only external gate cannot distinguish this empty run from a successful non-empty run without the new option.
unknowns: The report does not identify a particular production merge accepted because of this behavior.
